mapper.sql: select m.model_id, m.brand_id, b.brand_name, m.model_code, m.model_name, m.series_name, m.description, m.sort_order, m.status, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark from oc_product_model m left join oc_brand b on b.brand_id = m.brand_id
mapper.select:
m.del_flag = '0'
and m.brand_id = #{brandId}
and m.model_code like concat('%', #{modelCode}, '%')
and m.model_name like concat('%', #{modelName}, '%')
and m.series_name like concat('%', #{seriesName}, '%')
and m.status = #{status}
order by b.sort_order, m.sort_order, m.model_id
select count(1) from oc_product_model where del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from oc_product_model where brand_id = #{brandId} and del_flag = '0'
